facts.text: Serve the snacks when Beldar and Prymaat sit down to their first big feed on Earth.
facts.why: No first big meal on Earth is in the transcript or plot. What is shown is a neighbour being invited to consumption of mass quantities, with a flame pit and charred mammal flesh, at a weekend barbecue.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when the Coneheads invite the neighbours to consume mass quantities.
